tools.name: get_clueso_page
tools.description: Read any page of clueso.io as clean Markdown instead of rendered HTML. Pass a site path such as '/pricing', '/features/auto-translate' or '/blog/some-post'. Use '/' for the home page.

tools.name: get_clueso_pricing
tools.description: Get Clueso's current plans and prices — the free tier, Solo, Business and Enterprise, with the limits and features of each.

tools.name: search_clueso_site
tools.description: Search clueso.io for pages about a topic — features, pricing, comparisons, solutions, tutorials, glossary terms and customer stories. Returns matching page titles, URLs and one-line descriptions. Use this before guessing a URL.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. 'translate video' or 'SOC 2'
